diagnostics.message: :resource.local_file.public_ssh_key has an explicit depends_on on tls_private_key.ssh, but its content attribute (tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh) already establishes that dependency implicitly. The depends_on is redundant.

:resource.local_file.private_ssh_key has an explicit depends_on on tls_private_key.ssh, but its content attribute (tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem) already establishes that dependency implicitly. The depends_on is redundant.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance launches the runner instances whose user-data writes the GitLab registration token into aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token (value = "null", lifecycle.ignore_changes on value). Nothing orders the parameter's creation before the instances launch, so the user-data's SSM put-parameter can race Terraform's parameter creation (ParameterAlreadyExists) or clobber it. The autoscaling group should depend on the SSM parameter.
